faq.q: How do I install Homescapes on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Homescapes and check the developer is Playrix before tapping Install. Google Play only shows the Install button if your phone is compatible. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Playrix and may be altered, so the safest way to play Homescapes is the official listing.

faq.q: Homescapes or Gardenscapes: which is better?
faq.a: Both are Playrix match-3 games. Homescapes is about renovating a house with Austin the butler; Gardenscapes is about restoring a garden. The puzzles play almost the same, so pick the setting you prefer.

faq.q: Why is Homescapes not working after an update?
faq.a: Restart your phone, make sure there's enough free storage, and update Google Play services. If it still crashes, clear the game's cache; your progress is saved if your account is connected.
